target_tasks.name: Discover workspace, hardware and assets
target_tasks.criteria: Accurate detection of Pop!_OS, i7-1065G7, MX230, 12 videos, and ITD model; baseline tests recorded honestly.

target_tasks.name: Freeze schemas, clocks and evidence plan
target_tasks.criteria: Explicit 4-clock specification, CameraObservation schema, and PredictionSnapshot sanitizer definition.

target_tasks.name: Verify already-downloaded ITD v1.2 and dependency compatibility
target_tasks.criteria: SHA-256 match, 8 classes mapped, Ultralytics/ByteTrack loader verification, PyTorch CPU test.

target_tasks.name: Inventory twelve clips and source records
target_tasks.criteria: 12 clips indexed with SHA-256, duration, resolution, frame rate, and operational slot assignment.

target_tasks.name: Propose and verify camera geometry
target_tasks.criteria: Deterministic counting line, ROI polygon, and directional orientation for CAM-01..06 with valid coordinate bounds.

target_tasks.name: Implement detector, tracker and aggregate counts
target_tasks.criteria: Single-camera ByteTrack crossing counts, 5-second binning, valid JSONL observations matching camera-observation-v1 schema.

target_tasks.name: Implement concurrent processing
target_tasks.criteria: Concurrent processing of 12 camera sessions, bounded queues, backpressure handling, isolated tracker states.

target_tasks.name: Repair flow dynamics and metrics
target_tasks.criteria: Strict mass conservation, no negative queues, FIFO cell transfers, stability under CFL dt<=L/v condition.

target_tasks.name: Implement complete snapshot and sanitizer
target_tasks.criteria: State continuation equivalence test from snapshot, zero future event or seed leakage into predictor input.

target_tasks.name: Implement video-derived boundary demand
target_tasks.criteria: Delayed uniform release adapter from 5s bins, exact cumulative mass conservation check.

target_tasks.name: Implement causal demand forecasts and comparisons
target_tasks.criteria: Persistence and EWMA forecasting over 30s/60s/120s/300s horizons; candidate timing simulation scoring.

target_tasks.name: Implement Go API and persistence extensions
target_tasks.criteria: REST/WebSocket observation endpoints, mode selection (cached vs online), migration for video observation runs.

target_tasks.name: Integrate actual video and graph UI
target_tasks.criteria: Dual mode selection in UI, MP4 video player synchronization, source-derived flow charts.

target_tasks.name: Automate pre-annotation and qualified review
target_tasks.criteria: Export pseudo-labels in YOLO format, agent review log, comparison against baseline sample counts.

target_tasks.name: Execute integrated normal and failure tests
target_tasks.criteria: End-to-end simulation driven by video observations, camera disconnection degradation, surge recovery.

target_tasks.name: Benchmark target machine
target_tasks.criteria: FPS, latency (ms), CPU/VRAM usage for single camera and concurrent 12 sessions on target host.

target_tasks.name: Document, package and rehearse
target_tasks.criteria: Complete offline-ready package, documented procedures, honest readiness matrix.
